notes: No case ending, suffix, apostrophe or hyphen is attached to a placeholder or #; sentences use a colon, an explanatory noun (pelaaja {name}, kohteeseen {arg1}) or a nominative object (Päivitä {building}).
Plurals: one is only 1 (# soturi); other uses the partitive (# soturia), including 0. A plain number outside a plural follows a colon.

Generated names should be compounds (generatedNames: compound, not yet set in languages.json): first parts are stems (Ukkos, Rauta, Hiljais, Puna), second parts nominative nouns (Huippu, Portti, Kurki): Ukkoshuippu, Rautaportti, Kaksoisterä.
Finnish letters ä ö (and å) are in Latin-1, so the bundled fonts cover it; script names avoid š ž (Cham, Gujarati) so no system-font switch is needed.
The Japanese statutory pages are translated into Finnish with short Finnish titles; they are drafts, not a lawyer-reviewed translation.
Computer players’ generated names (Kaito Mori) are stored text and stay in Latin letters, as in every language.
